metadata.name: CKD-EPI 2021 eGFR (Race-Free Creatinine)
metadata.summary: 2021 race-free CKD-EPI creatinine equation estimating glomerular filtration rate (mL/min/1.73 m²) for CKD staging.
clinical_pearls: The 2021 CKD-EPI equation removes the race coefficient and is recommended by NKF/ASN and KDIGO for routine CKD staging.
For medication dosing (especially DOACs), check whether the drug label specifies Cockcroft-Gault CrCl (mL/min) rather than BSA-indexed eGFR.
Combined creatinine + cystatin C equations improve accuracy when muscle mass is abnormal, though creatinine-alone eGFR is adequate for most routine clinical decisions.

Pitfall — Unreliable populations & dialysis: Creatinine-based eGFR is inaccurate in acute kidney injury, dialysis, pregnancy, early diabetes before overt nephropathy, and extremes of muscle mass (amputees, paraplegia, severe malnutrition, obesity).

interpretation.label: G5 — Kidney Failure (< 15)
interpretation.summary: Kidney failure; nephrology co-management and dialysis consideration required.

interpretation.label: G4 — Severely Decreased (15–29.9)
interpretation.summary: Severely decreased GFR; high risk of contrast-associated AKI and drug accumulation.

interpretation.label: G3b — Moderately to Severely Decreased (30–44.9)
interpretation.summary: Moderate-to-severe reduction; review renally cleared therapies and contrast prophylaxis.

interpretation.label: G3a — Mildly to Moderately Decreased (45–59.9)
interpretation.summary: Mild-to-moderate reduction; monitor renal function and avoid nephrotoxins.

interpretation.label: G2 — Mildly Decreased (60–89.9)
interpretation.summary: Mildly decreased GFR relative to young adult level; CKD only if markers of kidney damage are present.

interpretation.label: G1 — Normal or High (>= 90)
interpretation.summary: Normal or high estimated glomerular filtration rate.

assessment_guides.title: When Creatinine-Based eGFR Is Unreliable
bedside_steps: Use standardized IDMS-traceable serum creatinine in steady-state patients.
pitfalls_and_exceptions: Inaccurate in acute kidney injury (non-steady state), extremes of muscle mass (amputation, neuromuscular atrophy, bodybuilders), or pregnancy.
Consider Cystatin C-based eGFR when muscle mass is markedly abnormal.

references.citation: Inker LA, Eneanya ND, Coresh J, et al. New Creatinine- and Cystatin C-Based Equations to Estimate GFR without Race. N Engl J Med. 2021;385(19):1737-1749.
Levey AS, Stevens LA, Schmid CH, et al. A new equation to estimate glomerular filtration rate. Ann Intern Med. 2009;150(9):604-612.
